source_boundary.availability: event_at AND source available_at AND immutable source observed_at at or before cutoff
source_boundary.local_import: Recorded independently; reconstruction relies on the synthetic source's historical revision journal, not a claim the local system saw records earlier

history.returns: reported separately; retained units subtract observed returns
history.stockouts: observed sales are lower bounds; never impute lost demand
history.missing: explicit missing flag and null demand, distinct from an observed zero
history.corrections: append-only source revisions, one original bucket identity and immutable captured observation time

targeted_fault: Filter by sale event time while ignoring when a later correction became observable
